mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% is followed by positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and negative 20-day forward returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points within a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 1 month is followed by positive 5-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between UNRATE rise and negative 5-day forward returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS MoM < -1% is followed by positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between RSAFS decline and negative 60-day forward returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM > 1% is followed by negative 20-day forward returns in > 40% of instances, or if the correlation between INDPRO increase and positive 20-day forward returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 5% signals a restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 5% is followed by positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between high FEDFUNDS and negative 60-day forward returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 2% month-over-month signals a broad-based demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the joint condition (HOUST MoM < -2% and RSAFS MoM < -2%) is followed by positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the joint effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs month-over-month signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases by > 200,000 jobs MoM is followed by negative 5-day forward returns in > 40% of instances, or if the correlation between PAYEMS increase and positive 5-day forward returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%) and a federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 3% signals a potential monetary policy mismatch, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the joint condition (CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and FEDFUNDS < 3%) is followed by positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the joint effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
